explanation: Their babble, sometimes called Penguinese, was improvised by Italian voice actor Carlo Bonomi. With no real words, the show could be sold abroad without dubbing.

claims.text: The characters in the Swiss TV series Pingu speak a made-up language with no real words, sometimes called 'Penguinese'.
Pingu's characters do not speak Swiss German, Italian or Norwegian.
In the original series, the voices were performed by the Italian voice actor Carlo Bonomi, who improvised the babble.
Because the dialogue has no real words, Pingu could be shown abroad without dubbing.
